regions.name: explorer1
regions.rationale: Focus on high-speed configurations with minimal seed length and low cap to ensure fast processing while maintaining enough specificity to avoid missing alignments.

regions.name: explorer2
regions.rationale: Optimize for moderate speed and accuracy by increasing seed length and cap slightly, balancing specificity and performance while still avoiding over-coverage of repeats.

regions.name: explorer3
regions.rationale: Prioritize accuracy and coverage by using longer seeds and higher cap values, ensuring that the configuration captures more potential alignments while still meeting the error threshold.
